page.overview:
Who is Eldaya Tolen?

Eldaya held the position for sixteen years until her death in . She was Beryl Marle's successor and Alvera Ramosanya's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was not weak but not strong either. She left Tower affairs to the Hall as long as she was able to manage her own manipulations elsewhere, which she did quite a lot.
